Cc: kate.hudson@helixpartners.com
Date: Tue, 29 Sep 2026 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: SOC2 spot audit: employee training & offboard evidence request

Hi Jonas,

As part of BrightShore's routine SOC2 sampling, our external reviewers need a small artifact set covering employee security training completion, post-training knowledge checks, and recent offboarding handback logs for a random 20-person sample from Q2–Q3 2026. Specifically we need: 

- Training completion exports (CSV) with timestamp and course ID.
- Results for our selected knowledge-checks (post-training quizzes), ideally anonymized IDs + score bands.
- Background-check confirmation (redacted PII) for the same sample.
- Offboard handback logs showing device/credential removal for people who left in the sampling window.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide these within two business days and whether any items require an NDA or additional redaction? We prefer a secure Drive link for artifacts.

Thanks,
G. Martinez
Senior Auditor, BrightShore
BrightShore Capital

[Attachment: SOC2_sample_spec.pdf (pdf)]

Laura / Grace —

Forwarding BrightShore's ask. They want a 20-person sample export and four artifact types: training completions CSV, knowledge-check results (anonymized), redacted background confirmations, and offboard handback logs. We have two business days from the auditor's email.

Please pull the following:
- training_completion_report_q3_2026.csv (filters: mandatory security playbook course, completion timestamp, user_id)
- knowledge-check-sample-results.jsonl (anonymized id, quiz_id, score_pct, taken_ts) — pick the standard 5-question post-course check used since Jan 2026
- bkchecks-sample-redacted.pdf (redact SSNs/DOB; show verification status and vendor reference only)
- offboard-account-handback-log.xlsx (device asset IDs, account deprovision timestamps, ticket refs)

Notes on sample selection: use random stratified sampling across teams (eng, product, sales, ops) — include at least 3 from sales and 3 from eng. Avoid contractors unless they appear in payroll as W-2.

Grace: please coordinate the redaction for background docs — use our standard redaction template and include chain-of-custody notes.

Laura: stage the Drive folder and set Viewer-only link; share link here when ready. Rishi, FYI on log formats and the offboard export.

I will send a short cover email to the auditor once we have the artifacts.

Jonas Weber
Head of Compliance Operations
Redwood Inference
